purpose: Audit whether the already-present full native DeepSeek expert-pack can advance the vendor DeepSeek 16GB cold-start SOTA without downloading new files.

accepted_binary.implication: The accepted SOTA binary does not link the batch expert-pack mmap helper used by GGML_MOE_CPU_FALLBACK_PACK_MMAP; the weak CPU-side extern resolves to the stub path.

historical_batch_probe_binary.implication: Can exercise the older batch expert-pack mmap path, but is not the accepted current SOTA binary.

why_full_pack_is_not_a_new_source_route: The full pack has exact gate/up/down coverage, but the current accepted binary has GGML_CUDA_MOE_STREAM_BATCH=OFF, so CPU fallback mmap cannot use GGML_MOE_EXPERT_PACK without rebuilding a different binary or reintroducing source changes.
The accepted France gate path already has zero one-pack misses with the smaller France gate pack, so replacing the gate one-pack with the full pack does not improve the accepted gate-cache path.

The only relevant benefit would be CPU fallback up/down source selection. The same mmap mechanism with top128/top256 up/down packs was already measured under strict cold 16GB and regressed to 4.1/4.0 tok/s despite correctness and RAM passing.

A full 147GB mmap pack would still fault file-backed pages inside the same 16GB cgroup; it changes source layout but not CPU fallback math or synchronization, and it can increase page-cache/refault pressure.
O_DIRECT/direct-staging variants for pack reads were previously bounded and measured as too narrow or too slow unless paired with a real compute/offload change.
analysis.theoretical_upper_bound: A perfect source-layout-only win cannot exceed removal of cold source/page overhead from CPU fallback. Prior mmap controls show the mechanism does not realize that bound; top256 covered 59.8GB of fallback payload and still regressed. Full-pack mmap has larger coverage but no new mechanism to reduce CPU math/sync or page-cache accounting.
analysis.correctness_status: No new model run was performed. Historical same-mechanism controls passed France correctness but did not improve token rate.

decision.reason: The full native expert-pack is already present and exact, but it only reopens the previously rejected CPU fallback pack-mmap/source-layout mechanism. It is not wired into the accepted binary, and same-mechanism strict-cold controls regressed. Running a full-pack mmap benchmark would not be a justified 10 tok/s step without a new compute/offload or direct-source hard-bound.

next_step: Continue with the active plan: obtain disk approval for full alternate GGUF empirical testing, or require a new hard-bound above 10 tok/s before source work.
